title: Node graph gets its own top-level package: api, field, runtime, syntax, analysis, optimize, catalog out of geometry/mesh; generic math/control/closure nodes with it; parsing/glsl to gui/ui/code
description:
Repo plan phase 1.2 (pure moves). The node-graph engine is not mesh-specific (it hosts dungeon, math, control, closure and curve nodes) but lives in geometry/mesh/{nodes/api, graph, curve, documentation} and parsing/python. Moves (class names unchanged, including MeshNode, PythonParser and PythonLexer):
- nodegraph/api: MeshNode, NodeContext, InputPort, OutputPort, PortType, MeshNodeSchema, ModeConstraint, CanonicalPortNames (from geometry/mesh/nodes/api).
- nodegraph/field: the *Field and *Value records, FieldContext, FieldBroadcast (nodes/math), FieldContextImpl, MeshFieldContext (graph), FloatCurveKernel (mesh/curve).
- nodegraph/runtime: NodeGraphRuntime, GraphNodeContext, NodeGroup, GroupBuilder, GroupLibrary, HeapSampler, AutoTagHook.
- nodegraph/syntax: parsing/python/*; MathExpressionEvaluator under syntax/expr.
- nodegraph/analysis: GraphValidator, GraphAnalyzer. nodegraph/optimize: Input/LiteralParameterDescriptor, OptimizableParameter, SkeletonSensitivityAnalyzer (mesh/data), BatchDslEvaluator.
- nodegraph/catalog: MeshNodeCatalog, ExportMeshNodeCatalog, NodeInspector (from automation endpoints/mesh/dsl).
- nodegraph/nodes/{math,control,closure} from geometry/mesh/nodes.
- geometry/mesh/nodes/quadlayout and nodes/network to geometry/mesh/quadlayout/nodes (NetworkTracer to quadlayout/embedding); nodes/patch CharrotGregoryPatch and CoonsHandleBuilder next to their evaluators.
- parsing/glsl to gui/ui/code/glsl; the parsing package disappears.
MeshNodeRegistry's type string and the catalog categories must already be move-safe (blocked by the move-safety ticket).

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. geometry/mesh/graph, geometry/mesh/curve, geometry/mesh/nodes/api and parsing/ no longer exist.
2. Behaviour is unchanged: the unit suite passes, every scene in CanvasSceneMap still launches, and the generated registries (MeshNodeRegistry, SceneRegistry, CommandRegistry, AutomationRouteRegistry) and automation_routes.json list the same ids as master. Moved packages carry their package-info.java, and ARCHITECTURE.md is regenerated by SpliceArchitectureDoc. No class is renamed.
3. mesh-node-catalog.json is identical to master (categories come from the annotation).
4. Launch entry and a screenshot of the quad-layout scene with the ctrl+G graph view.
testing-plan:
1. mvn test; catalog and route JSON diff.
2. Live: mesh-viewer on a DSL, node-inspect and model --set via ixdar-cli, ctrl+G graph view.
unknowns: Package name: nodegraph vs dsl; the user has not ruled yet. Default: ixdar.nodegraph.
changes-made: Moved the node-graph engine to ixdar.nodegraph (classes keep their names): api (MeshNode, NodeContext, MapNodeContext, ports, PortType, MeshNodeSchema, ModeConstraint, CanonicalPortNames), field (*Field/*Value, FieldContext, FieldBroadcast, FieldContextImpl, MeshFieldContext, FloatCurveKernel), runtime (NodeGraphRuntime, GraphNodeContext, NodeGroup, GroupBuilder, GroupLibrary, HeapSampler, AutoTagHook), syntax (PythonLexer, PythonParser) with syntax/expr (MathExpressionEvaluator), analysis (GraphValidator, GraphAnalyzer), optimize (parameter descriptors, OptimizableParameter, SkeletonSensitivityAnalyzer, BatchDslEvaluator), catalog (MeshNodeCatalog, ExportMeshNodeCatalog, NodeInspector), nodes/{math,control,closure}. nodes/quadlayout + nodes/network -> geometry/mesh/quadlayout/nodes (NetworkTracer -> quadlayout/embedding); CharrotGregoryPatch and CoonsHandleBuilder -> geometry/mesh/data next to CoonsEvaluator/CharrotGregoryPatchSampler; parsing/glsl -> gui/ui/code/glsl. geometry/mesh/{graph,curve,nodes/api} and parsing/ are gone; ValidateDsl stays in geometry/mesh/documentation. Every new package has a package-info; ARCHITECTURE.md re-spliced; pom exec mainClasses updated. Verified: mvn test 521/521 pass; mesh-node-catalog.json and automation_routes.json byte-identical to eng-19; generated MeshNode (104+20 desktop), Scene (19), Command (28), AutomationRoute (51), Geometry (6) registries list identical ids.
